column9: Take the Disengage or Dash action as a Bonus Action; your jump distance is doubled.

When you roll Initiative, regain all expended Focus Points and roll your Martial Arts die + your Monk level to regain that many Hit Points (once per Long Rest).

column4: note:Cast Find Familiar without Material components
column9: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to cast the Find Familiar spell without Material components. When you cast the spell in this way, the familiar is Fey and disappears when you finish a Long Rest.
You can expend one use of Wild Shape (no action required) to give yourself a level 1 spell slot, but you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
Once on each of your turns, if you have no uses of Wild Shape left, you can give yourself one use by expending a spell slot (no action required).

You can convert uses of Wild Shape into a spell slot (no action required). Choose a number of your unexpended uses of Wild Shape and convert them into a single spell slot, with each use contributing 2 spell levels. For example, if you convert two uses of Wild Shape, you produce a level 4 spell slot. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of yourself. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. One creature of your choice in that area regains 2d6 Hit Points. The damage and healing increase by 1d6 when you reach Druid levels 10 (3d6) and 14 (4d6).

column4: note:Spectral trees and vines fill a 15-foot Cube within 120 feet for 1 minute
column9: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. They last there for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition or die. You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there. As a Bonus Action, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet to ground within 120 feet of yourself.
Touch yourself and restore Hit Points from the pool, up to the amount remaining in it.

column4: note:Restore that many Hit Points to the creature you touch
column9: Touch a creature and restore Hit Points to it from the pool, up to the amount remaining in it.

column4: note:Remove the Poisoned condition from the creature you touch
column9: Expend 5 Hit Points from the pool to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature. Those points restore no Hit Points.

Roll the dice and add your Wisdom modifier: restore that many Hit Points to a creature within 30 feet, or it makes a Constitution save and takes that much Necrotic or Radiant damage, half on a success.

column4: note:Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute
column9: Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions for 1 minute, ending early if it takes any damage.

column4: note:Divide five times your Cleric level in Hit Points among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet, none above half its maximum
column9: Restore Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level, divided among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet (which can include you). A creature is restored to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.

column4: note:For 10 minutes you know where Celestials, Fiends and Undead within 60 feet are
column9: For 10 minutes, you know the location and type of any Celestial, Fiend or Undead within 60 feet, and detect consecrated or desecrated places and objects.

column4: note:Creatures up to your Charisma modifier within 60 feet make a Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute
column9: Target creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) within 60 feet. Each must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

column4: note:For 10 minutes add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attack rolls with the Melee weapon you hold
column9: When you take the Attack action, imbue a Melee weapon you hold: for 10 minutes, add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to its attack rolls, and its hits may deal Radiant damage.

column4: note:The creature you hit makes a Constitution save or is Stunned until the start of your next turn
column9: Once per turn when you hit with a Monk weapon or an Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point. On a failed Constitution save the target is Stunned until the start of your next turn. On a success its Speed is halved and the next attack against it has Advantage.
